name: Jack
canonical_visual_description: Jack is an adventurous young cartoon boy with curly brown hair peeking out from under a bright orange cap. He has big expressive green eyes, a sweet smile, and wears a white collared shirt with an orange vest, a red neckerchief, green shorts, and grey shoes.

name: Jill
canonical_visual_description: Jill is a cheerful young cartoon girl with dark brown hair tied in a ponytail featuring a bright red bow headband. She has large expressive brown eyes, cute freckles, and wears a bright red button-up dress.
